declares_what_is_bound_today_not_what_ou: this records the artifact the forward path ACTUALLY binds today. R-497 (C) and the reviewer both note it is arm A's frozen LINEAR (PM_PLUS_FINE), not LGBM_PINNED. Whether that is the intended forward candidate is a FREEZE-level ruling and is NOT decided here; what this file does is make any drift from it refuse rather than score quietly.
who_may_change_this: the USER (rule 12: a freeze is a commit)
why: the EXPECTED identity of the artifact the forward path scores with. Declared in a committed file because candidate_identity() hashes whatever CANDIDATE names and is self-consistent by construction, so it can never detect that CANDIDATE names the wrong model (BEM-R3).
